We are looking for a PhD candidate to investigate how to support work in healthcare settings through human-robot interaction.

The position is part of a new interdisciplinary initiative where we investigate how robots in clinical settings can communicate intentions, support collaboration, and are experienced by human users. The project combines real-world field studies in healthcare environments with prototype design and development, with room to shape the direction based on the candidate's interests.

We offer an active, collaborative team in an international research environment committed to excellent research and a friendly atmosphere.

This is a three-year fully funded position.

Start date: August 2026 onward (flexible)

Location: Dept. of Computer Science, Aalborg University, Aalborg Denmark.
